summary: Short kerb at a residential street end, houses 14-18 m away.

best_section.where: East kerb at the bend where Clarence Road ends beside bushland

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 14 m east and 18 m west; thick bush to the south of the bend.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars already parked along it; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end residential street, very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the kerb; no signs mapped here, no camping convention.

flags: Quiet residential street with no overnight parking convention
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the south end; open to morning sun from the east.
